brand.name: Chez Shashou
brand.headline: Manje lakay, made with love.
brand.intro: Weekend plates from Vasthie's kitchen: griot, diri djon djon, pikliz and more. Order ahead, then pick up hot and ready.

about.title: Bonjou, I'm Vasthie
about.text:
Most people call me Shashou. I grew up in Haiti watching my mother and grandmother cook. In our house the kitchen was where everyone gathered, and Sunday meant a full table.

I cook the same way today, in small batches with fresh epis, and only on the weekends I announce here. Every plate is made to order, so please order early. When it's gone, it's gone!
about.area: Pickup in the neighborhood. You'll get the exact address when your order is confirmed.

ordering.paymentNote: Pay when you pick up: cash, Zelle or Cash App.

announcements.title: Soup joumou is back
announcements.text: Sunday only, and there are just 20 quarts. Reserve yours early!

dishes.name: Griot
dishes.subtitle: Crispy fried pork
dishes.description: Pork shoulder marinated overnight in epis and sour orange, simmered until tender, then fried until crispy. Served with bannann peze, pikliz and sauce ti malice.

dishes.name: Plat konplè
dishes.subtitle: The full plate
dishes.description: A bit of everything: tasso (fried beef), diri kole ak pwa, a fresh salad and pikliz. Made for a big appetite.

dishes.name: Diri ak legim
dishes.subtitle: Rice & vegetable stew
dishes.description: Slow-cooked legim of eggplant, cabbage, chayote and spinach over diri kole ak pwa, with bannann peze on the side.

dishes.name: Espageti ayisyen
dishes.subtitle: Haitian breakfast spaghetti
dishes.description: Spaghetti tossed with sliced hot dogs, peppers, onions and a tomato-epis sauce, the way it's made back home.

dishes.name: Soup joumou
dishes.subtitle: Independence squash soup
dishes.description: Our freedom soup: kabocha squash, beef, pasta, potatoes, carrots and cabbage. Rich and warming. Available Sundays only.

dishes.name: Bannann peze
dishes.subtitle: Twice-fried green plantains
dishes.description: Green plantains, fried, smashed, then fried again until golden. Perfect with pikliz.

dishes.name: Pikliz
dishes.subtitle: Spicy pickled slaw
dishes.description: Cabbage, carrots and onions pickled with scotch bonnet peppers in vinegar. It's hot, it keeps for weeks in the fridge, and it goes with everything.

dishes.name: Pate kòde
dishes.subtitle: Fried patties
dishes.description: Flaky fried dough filled with seasoned beef or smoked herring. Tell us which filling you want in your order note.

dishes.name: Akra
dishes.subtitle: Malanga fritters
dishes.description: Crispy fritters of grated malanga, herbs and scotch bonnet. Best eaten hot.

dishes.name: Pen patat
dishes.subtitle: Sweet potato pudding
dishes.description: Baked sweet potato pudding with coconut milk, banana, ginger, cinnamon and a hint of vanilla.

dishes.name: Ji grenadya
dishes.subtitle: Fresh passion fruit juice
dishes.description: Freshly made passion fruit juice, lightly sweetened. Ask for it extra cold.
